# gap means removing its line. Kinds: refused (unknown attribute, 400), read-only (400),
# requires (we require, the spec does not), missing (never returned), content-type (415),
# base path. Behaviour gaps (states, rewrites, order) are in docs/tmf-gap-analysis.md.
